content.body: The Panzer IIC was the natural evolution of the Wehrmacht early training tanks, upgunned with a 20mm automatic cannon in place of the light machinegun Panzer I from the interwar years. Due to production delays and teething problems with the early Panzer III's and IV's, the Panzer IIC ended up being deployed in unexpected numbers. It was in fact used as a main battle tank in Poland, where more than 90% of the tanks used were Pz.I's Pz.II's. pziic handlers/unit
